direction: Evolve the L2a static merge hook towards (a) stronger tight-capacity awareness — raise the dimensionless capacity-fill bonus weight and give the depot-distance-difference term mu a larger share when residual capacity is near one maximum demand — and (b) reclaim the timing headroom (median ≈2.4 ms vs the 25 ms budget) with a deterministic intra-route 2-opt postprocess, leaving relocate_2opt unused so the budget envelope stays safe.

operations.mechanism: KB method-cvrp-m2-l2a-generalized-savings is the direct ancestor of this template+postprocess=none solver (dev_24 16.1595) and shows the normalized generalized savings form scaled by mean(d(0,1..n)) plus a capacity-fill bonus is both the best-scoring and the cheapest (≈2.4 ms median) L2a rule; the round-1 result (16.1721 at 1.84 ms) sits on the same frontier, so the exploitable slack is time, not score shape alone. KB method-cvrp-m2-l2b-dynamic-state-merge gives the quantitative boundary: dynamic candidate refresh cost 3.7x p95 and caused 40/120 budget-exhaustion collapses at 25 ms, which is why this plan keeps the static hook (no per-merge refresh) and spends the remaining budget only on an O(1)-delta intra-route move. KB method-cvrp-intra-2opt documents intra-route 2-opt as a deterministic, already validated low-risk improvement on top of parallel Clarke-Wright, and the archive weakest regimes (capacity tight −21.5%, size 100, uniform demand) are exactly where leftover edge crossings inside long routes concentrate, since tight capacity forces more-merged routes on 100-node instances. Combining a capacity-fill-weighted static score with intra 2-opt therefore targets the two failure modes that the single-solver portfolio (gap_over_sbs 0.0%, VBS==SBS) cannot cover by itself.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: Round-1 L2a reached dev_24 mean 16.1721 at 1.84 ms/instance, i.e. only ~7% of the 25 ms budget is consumed. Therefore (H1) appending deterministic intra-route 2-opt cannot trigger budget-exhaustion degradation (observed only for dynamic-refresh L2b-ctrl at 40/120 in the 25 ms regime) and should lower mean objective by at least ~1.5% versus postprocess=none; and (H2) since the weakest regime is capacity_level=tight (vbs_rel_gap −21.5%) plus size=100/uniform demand, re-weighting the generalized-savings score toward the dimensionless capacity-fill bonus and mu*|d(0,i)-d(0,j)| will improve the tight-capacity subset specifically without regressing clustered instances, because both terms remain scale-normalized by mean(d(0,1..n)) and thus stay coordinate-scaling invariant (0.00% drift).
